description: Suggest ready-made automations for a From app (where work starts) and a To app (where results go). Use app slugs from list_automation_apps, or speak for Speak itself. Each suggestion has a status and, when ready, a draft to adapt and save with create_automation; the draft leaves the folder empty for you to fill. An email or file app paired with an app that takes results is two linked automations: draft is the intake (the trigger, then speak-upload into a folder) and linkedDraft acts on it (media analysed in that folder, an AI step, then the action). Put the one folder the user picks in the intake's speak-upload folderId and in linkedDraft's trigger.folderIds, then call create_automation with the intake and linkedAutomationBody set to linkedDraft. Read-only: nothing is created.

from.description: App slug where the work starts, or speak

to.description: App slug where the results go, or speak
